local _HnNn8T3va4CA=211 local _TFFX4H6abv3F=97

local function _dzO2R7s8lQkkG1n(_KHQpx,_xvD8V5o)
    local _HfBO4HJ7z=(_HnNn8T3va4CA+(_KHQpx*7)+(_TFFX4H6abv3F%13)+(_KHQpx*_TFFX4H6abv3F%17))%256
    if bit32 then return bit32.bxor(_xvD8V5o,_HfBO4HJ7z)%256 end
    local _r=0
    for _bit=0,7 do
        local _a=math.floor(_xvD8V5o/(2^_bit))%2
        local _k=math.floor(_HfBO4HJ7z/(2^_bit))%2
        if _a~=_k then _r=_r+(2^_bit) end
    end
    return _r%256
end
